title: An agreement beyond binding convenience

captions.physics: Sharing household work according to reality
captions.energy: Rejecting whole arrangements over a flaw

meaning: Your domestic agreement becomes freer when an error reveals an actual need instead of only changing rules for maintaining untouchable comfort.
text: You can arrange support through fair participation: considering work, discussing the load and recognising both contributions. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Tower in energy tests your footing through abruptly rejecting the entire scheme after a flaw. The Devil in emotions holds to ready material comfort. The agreement becomes difficult to change: existing order seems unusable, yet the possessions and conveniences it serves remain untouchable. Every new scheme must solve the same excessive task, as though reducing its scale were no longer permitted.

For example, work maintaining extensive household supplies is divided. One shelf cannot hold essentials, prompting rejection of the whole division without discussion of quantities. **Not every inconvenience needs another agreement around the same load.** A binding habit can be recognised without dismissing what was accumulated. Fairness includes actual need, beyond deciding who should move and organise more of what both fear calmly releasing.

The difficulty is seeking a better scheme after every setback while keeping all existing comfort intact. Rules change, work stays and disappointment repeats. Home demands more maintenance. Support grows through discussing obligations’ content: if convenience restricts freedom, a fair agreement need not indefinitely confirm its exclusive right to occupy so much shared time and space. What is useful can then be reconsidered alongside who maintains it.
